references.title: en.wiktionary: Waterloo
references.supports: Proper noun, the town in Belgium; no German etymology

notes.rationale: die Schlacht von Waterloo, the town in Belgium, a place name with a Core gender (Neut, Rule de/proper-noun-article). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root waterloo and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
